subject: Data Engineering
title: Apache Hudi Explained
description: A quick win: understand Apache Hudi Explained.

hook.text: Uber needed to update rows in a data lake efficiently. They built Hudi — Hadoop Upserts Deletes and Incrementals.

buildup.text: Hudi was designed for workloads that need frequent row-level updates, like ride-share trip data.

discovery.text: Hudi supports upserts natively, making it efficient for CDC pipelines that update existing records.

twist.text: While Iceberg and Delta gained broader adoption, Hudi remains strong for update-heavy, streaming-first workloads.

climax.text: All three formats — Delta, Iceberg, Hudi — solve the same core problem with different design trade-offs.

punchline.text: Three formats. Same goal. Different strengths.

quiz.question: What workload was Apache Hudi originally designed for?
options: Frequent row-level updates like ride-share trip data
